subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat implement only message Copy/Select Copy first, or the full Copy/Select Copy/Share/Reply long-press menu requested here?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but Share and Reply expand the feature beyond basic copy/select behavior and prior same-scope PRs were closed without landing, so automation should not choose the product scope.

options.title: Start With Copy And Select Copy
options.body: Land the smallest message-reuse surface that addresses the reported copy/select gap while preserving scroll, code-block selection, and link behavior.

options.title: Implement The Full Menu
options.body: Include Share and Reply in the first Android action sheet, accepting the larger UI and composer/draft scope.

options.title: Defer Message Actions
options.body: Keep current code-block-only selection and leave broader mobile message reuse for a later app UX pass.

recommendation.title: Start With Copy And Select Copy
recommendation.body: Land the smallest message-reuse surface that addresses the reported copy/select gap while preserving scroll, code-block selection, and link behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Android chat UI history and live PR metadata make this the strongest available owner signal for the product-scope choice.
